open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Fiat turbulence (VIX-correlated) is the primary stress propagation channel (2605.30442) — precedes crypto repricing. During risk-off, institutional leveraged long demand collapses on crypto perps 12-24h before spot reprices, compressing funding rates. VIX>25 identifies onset of this sequence. Kill-switch: reduce Strategy B 50% or exit fully when VIX closes >25; re-enter when VIX <20 on close.

open_hypotheses.description: Replacing Strategy A's 28-bar rolling std with a HAR(1,5,22) heterogeneous autoregressive vol estimator improves vol targeting accuracy and reduces crash-regime over-sizing, because BTC/ETH/SOL realized vol exhibits long memory (Hurst H > 0.5) that a single-scale window cannot capture.
open_hypotheses.data_required: BTC/ETH/SOL daily returns (Binance klines, already in Strategy A pipeline). No new data fetch required.
open_hypotheses.conflict_with_archived: none — Strategy A's 28-bar window is canonical but no alternative vol estimator has been tested or archived. HAR-TSMOM not in archived research history.
origin_themes: T7 (2606.06190 + 2606.09478) — regime-conditioned vol forecasting outperforms single-scale GARCH
open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: BTC/ETH/SOL realized vol has long memory (Hurst H ~0.6-0.8). HAR(1,5,22) decomposes vol into daily/weekly/monthly components, providing earlier detection of vol expansion via weekly and monthly components already trending upward. The 28-bar rolling window lags because it is dominated by recent low-vol observations. This lag contributed to over-sizing just before the 2026-05-11 propfirm breach.

If ≥0.95: close H004, H002 proceeds with vol_28d unchanged.
open_hypotheses.success_criterion: RMSE improvement ≥5% on holdout 2024-2026 → incorporate. <5% → close H004.

open_hypotheses.description: A rolling 3-day pairwise return correlation between BTC/ETH/SOL exceeding 0.90 with all three assets co-negative identifies onset of the near-complete lower tail copula regime and should trigger a 50% Strategy A position reduction before the reactive MAX_TOTAL_DD guardrail fires.
open_hypotheses.data_required: BTC/ETH/SOL daily returns (already in Strategy A pipeline). No new data needed.
open_hypotheses.conflict_with_archived: none — L11 establishes average correlation ≥0.80 but does not address tail copula trigger or proactive guardrail mechanics. No prior guardrail research archived.
open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: L11 establishes baseline BTC/ETH/SOL correlation ≥0.80 in all regimes. 2606.16840 shows that during crashes, the effective copula approaches completeness — standard models underestimate joint-crash prob by ~8×. When rolling 3d pairwise correlation of negative-return days exceeds 0.90 simultaneously across all three pairs, the portfolio has entered the high-density lower tail copula region. A proactive 50% size reduction at this point costs at most 3-4 days of carry; it reduces P(MAX_TOTAL_DD breach) from the tail copula regime materially.
open_hypotheses.success_criterion: N_events ≥ 10 (2020-2026) AND t_HAC(IC) > 2.0 → register as Strategy A modification candidate. N < 10 → document as manual monitoring heuristic (threshold: all 3 pairs > 0.90 AND all 3 daily returns negative), revisit when 5y+ daily data available.
open_hypotheses.priority_note: W25 P2 add-on to H004 session (~1h additional). Strategy A modification #1 candidate (alongside H002 and H004 — prioritize by expected PnL impact before committing).
open_hypotheses.caveat: N_events of full synchronization (all 3 pairs > 0.90 simultaneously AND all 3 negative) in 2020-2026 is likely 5-15 events — borderline power. IC test may be inconclusive.

open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Visible TWAP execution on HL broadcasts the order schedule, allowing liquidity providers to post contra-side limit orders in advance, reducing spread and adverse selection premium paid by the executor. Hidden IOC orders trigger informed participants to lean directionally, amplifying execution costs. At $1K-$5K mainnet notional, TWAP over 15-30 min window should reduce per-trade drag vs IOC.
open_hypotheses.success_criterion: Binary: HL API supports TWAP at $1K-$5K notional → implement for mainnet. Does not support → document limitation, keep IOC with event-time impact calibration.
